sounds.prompt: A police clerk typing a booking form on a manual mechanical typewriter: a quick burst of about a dozen key clacks, then the bell and the carriage return slide. 1980s office, dry, close, no room reverb, no music, no voice.
sounds.reason: Take 1 is fourteen even key clacks with the carriage slide at the end of the burst; take 2 is three short bursts ending in the bell. Two takes for variety between bookings. Takes 3 and 4 were not played.

sounds.prompt: A rubber stamp pressed hard on an ink pad then thumped onto a paper form on a wooden desk: a soft pad press, then one firm dull thump. Close, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice.
sounds.reason: Take 3 is one dry firm thump with a short paper decay and take 4 a soft pad press into the thump, the stamp landing on the sheet. Takes 1 and 2 are two separate hits 0.7 s apart that read as two actions, and take 2 rings.
